acpira.conf.defaultAgent: The default agent for new sessions
acpira.conf.language: Interface language; auto follows VS Code
acpira.conf.sessionScope: Which sessions the list shows: those opened in this workspace folder, or every session on this machine
acpira.conf.sessionScope.workspace: Sessions opened in the current workspace folder
acpira.conf.sessionScope.all: Every session on this machine, tagged with its project
acpira.conf.agents: Add custom ACP agents: `{ "<id>": { "name": "display name", "command": "executable", "args": ["..."], "login": "login command", "install": { "command": "install line", "docs": "URL" } } }`
acpira.conf.compactAtTokens: When the agent's reported usage.used reaches this many tokens, /compact is sent automatically before the next message (a running turn cannot be interrupted). Only applies to agents that report usage and offer a /compact command; models with a smaller context window are the agent's own lookout
acpira.conf.autoCompact: Send /compact automatically before the next message once over the threshold (turn off to compact by hand from the context panel only)
acpira.conf.hiddenOptions: Option families hidden from the menus (models / reasoning levels…): `{ "<agent>": { "<configOption id>": ["<family name>", ...] } }`. Toggle them on the agent page in Acpira settings; hand-editing is rarely needed
acpira.conf.theme: Color scheme of the Acpira panels: auto follows the VS Code theme, light / dark ignore it
acpira.conf.sessionListPosition: Session list position inside Acpira: collapsed, left, or right. Narrow panels use a drawer.
acpira.conf.uiFontSize: Base font size of the interface in px (10–20)
acpira.conf.codeFontSize: Base font size of code blocks, tool output and diffs in px (9–20)
acpira.conf.diffMarkers: Diff markers: color tints changed lines, signs relies on the +/- prefixes alone
acpira.conf.fontSmoothing: Render text with -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased (thinner strokes; macOS only)
acpira.conf.appearance.surface: Surface: hairline thin lines / tonal borderless layering / stroke outlines
acpira.conf.appearance.toolLine: Tool line: text only / with icon / icon + meta
acpira.conf.appearance.motion: Interface animation (transitions, entrances, shimmer): on / none. The working indicator keeps turning either way
acpira.conf.appearance.fold: Process-line folding: keep the whole turn in one fold showing the current action while running and the elapsed time when done, click to expand / fold read-only actions only (edits and commands stay visible)
